mcp_tools.name: production_python_engineering_pack
mcp_tools.title: Production python engineering pack
mcp_tools.description: Submits a production Python engineering record (environment, declared dependency rows, typing and style, errors, resources and async practices, testing, packaging, red lines) and returns a deterministic PRODUCTION_PYTHON_ENGINEERING_PACK_READY / PRODUCTION_PYTHON_ENGINEERING_PACK_NOT_READY / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed dependency pinning and duplication checks over the declared rows, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared engineering record only; it runs no code and reviews no repository.

inputSchema.description: The production python engineering pack manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).
